name: Core inducible PGE2
formula: mean of donor-group gene-wise z-scored mean log1p expression
biological_note: PLA2G4A -> PTGS2 -> PTGES core inducible route

name: Extended enzymatic PGE2
formula: mean of donor-group gene-wise z-scored mean log1p expression
biological_note: PLA2G4A plus PTGS1/2 and PTGES/PTGES2; excludes PTGES3

name: Original six-gene sensitivity
genes: PLA2G4A, PTGS1, PTGS2, PTGES, PTGES2, PTGES3
formula: mean of donor-group gene-wise z-scored mean log1p expression

name: Bottleneck-aware PGE2
formula: geometric_mean(PLA2G4A/q95, max(PTGS1,PTGS2)/q95, max(PTGES,PTGES2)/q95), each component clipped to [0,1]
biological_note: requires upstream, cyclooxygenase, and terminal synthase support simultaneously
